Superside is hiring a Senior FP&A Manager to own forecasting and strategic financial modeling across our Go-To-Market organization. Reporting to the FP&A Director, you’ll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps leaders to shape revenue strategy, validate growth assumptions, and ensure our plans reflect business reality.
 
This role matters now because GTM complexity is increasing. We need a data-savvy finance leader who can connect the dots across pipeline, hiring, incentives, and retention, turning ambiguity into clear financial direction.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring a Senior FP&A Manager to own forecasting and strategic financial modeling across our Go-To-Market organization. Reporting to the FP&A Director, you’ll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps leaders to shape revenue strategy, validate growth assumptions, and ensure our plans reflect business reality.
 
This role matters now because GTM complexity is increasing. We need a data-savvy finance leader who can connect the dots across pipeline, hiring, incentives, and retention, turning ambiguity into clear financial direction.

lists.content:
• Own revenue forecasting across New Business, Expansion, and Churn, ensuring accurate MRR modeling and visibility.
  • Build and maintain scenario models that inform hiring plans, capacity planning, and investment decisions.
  • Partner with GTM leadership to define ROI metrics, profitability targets, and performance tracking frameworks.
  • Collaborate with RevOps and Data teams to improve financial reporting accuracy and data accessibility.
  • Model and validate sales incentive plans, ramp assumptions, and hiring roadmaps.
  • Track and analyze core SaaS KPIs including pipeline conversion, retention, and revenue efficiency.
  • Support Business Unit leaders with structured profitability analysis and actionable insights.
  • Drive automation and process improvements across reporting, dashboards, and planning workflows.

• Professional finance qualification (CA, CIMA, CFA, or equivalent).
  • 7+ years of experience in finance or FP&A roles within data-rich environments.
  • Strong SaaS and GTM metrics knowledge, including MRR dynamics, retention, pipeline, and revenue forecasting.
  • Advanced modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools (e.g., Omni) and SQL is a plus.
  • Ability to move between detailed analysis and executive-level storytelling.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Strong prioritization skills and comfort managing competing deadlines.
  • Experience in a SaaS company is strongly preferred.

Reporting to the FP&A Director, you’ll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps leaders to shape revenue strategy, validate growth assumptions, and ensure our plans reflect business reality.
 
This role matters now because GTM complexity is increasing. We need a data-savvy finance leader who can connect the dots across pipeline, hiring, incentives, and retention, turning ambiguity into clear financial direction.

lists.content:
• Own product strategy and execution for Superspace, balancing customer value, business impact, and operational efficiency.

  • Lead a cross-functional pod of product designers, engineering leaders, and engineers to deliver high-impact outcomes.

  • Partner with Operations and Services teams to improve workflows and drive measurable business results.

  • Define how Superspace serves multiple user groups, from enterprise customers to internal creative and project teams.

  • Create cohesive product experiences by aligning work across multiple product teams and initiatives.

  • Shape AI-native workflows that combine human expertise, AI agents, and proprietary data.

  • Establish frameworks for prioritization, ensuring resources are focused on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Prototype, validate, and iterate on product concepts in close collaboration with Design and Engineering.

  • Drive adoption, engagement, and efficiency through continuous product improvement.

  • Influence product strategy alongside senior leaders across Product, Engineering, and the executive team.

• 8+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years in Senior or Staff-level roles.

  • Experience leading complex B2B, platform, marketplace, AI, or workflow products.

  • Strong product judgment with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Deep curiosity about AI and hands-on experience working with AI-powered products and workflows.

  • Ability to balance the needs of customers, internal users, technical constraints, and business goals.

  • Strong product craft with a passion for building intuitive, high-quality user experiences.

  • Experience leading multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously in fast-paced environments.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Ability to work closely with technical teams and confidently discuss architecture, AI capabilities, and implementation trade-offs.

  • Experience using data and experimentation to drive product decisions.
